title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：pride　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pride 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the elder ① kept the pride that no youth in the village would have measured, and he said the keeping was the whole of the year. The ② pride, meaning the dignity itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; pride, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ bit of pride in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ pride at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Pride, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the elder said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pride was the whole of the matter, meaning the honour and not the dignity. The ⑥ pride, meaning the honour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; pride, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both dignity and an honour. He said the honour is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ pride had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ pride of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of measuring; pride, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pride I remember is the pride measured in the memoir, which closed in 1983 and is still measured as the quietest in the village. ⑩ Pride, my mother said in 1985, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all pride, she said, is an honour that has agreed to look like dignity. She said the honour was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 骄傲；自豪（指村子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 骄傲；自豪（指那份骄傲本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the pride 守住这一份骄傲
D. n. 骄傲；自豪（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 骄傲之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的骄傲之事）
F. n. 骄傲；自豪（指回忆录里写到、被测量的那一份）
G. n. 骄傲、体面（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 体面（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the pride that no youth in the village would have measured
The pride, meaning the dignity itself and not the staff
Every bit of pride in that village
the pride at the far gate
the pride was the whole of the matter
the pride had become a line in a memoir
The pride of the whole thing

answers.why: keep the pride 意为“守住这一份骄傲”，1976 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯测量的一份骄傲做了一遍。
pride 意为“骄傲；自豪”，指那份骄傲本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被测量。
pride 意为“骄傲；自豪”，指村子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
pride 意为“骄傲；自豪”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pride 意为“骄傲、体面”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份体面就是那件事的全部。
pride 意为“体面”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份骄傲，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pride 意为“骄傲；自豪”，指回忆录里写到、被测量的那一份，到 1981 年这一份成了回忆录里的一行。
pride 意为“骄傲之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的骄傲之事是一处村子和三个年头的测量。
pride 意为“骄傲；自豪”，我记得的是回忆录里测量过的那一份，1983 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一份。
pride 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，骄傲是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的骄傲。
